claude.result:
Confirmed the season is fully locked out (budget $50 < $80 floor since d176, no path to book anything through season end) and pulled the complete final fall-run table plus a second ONI calibration point to sharpen the season-3 plan.

**What I changed:** Rewrote `notes.md` with the final S2 outcome (rank fell from 1→12 as competitors who preserved cash captured the fall run), the complete doy240-330 day_1_5/overnight/3Q table for both seasons (confirms S2's fall run ramped ~25 days earlier and overnight actually out-peaked day_1_5 at 6.14 share/angler), and a two-point ONI calibration (S1 -0.98→-1.24 = late window, S2 -0.37→-0.50 = early window) to set S3's watch-start date.

**Why:** The core failure this season was spending 97% of budget on low-yield spring three_quarter probing before the fall window opened, locking out the highest-leverage weeks of the year. The updated notes set a hard budget-cap rule (~40% pre-fall) and a live-signal-confirmed (not calendar-only) trigger for S3, since fixed-rule bots without live confirmation scored near zero both seasons.
